entities.name: Laonikos Chalkokondyles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Laonikos Chalkokondyles, also latinized as Laonicus Chalcocondyles, was a Byzantine Greek historian from Athens. He is known for his Demonstrations of Histories in ten books, which record the last 150 years of the Byzantine Empire.
